title: Architecture overview
text: The service is split into three parts: the API gateway, the worker pool, and the storage layer. The gateway handles authentication and rate limiting before passing requests to the workers. Workers pull jobs from a queue and write their results to the storage layer, which is backed by Postgres and an object store for large files. This design lets us scale each part independently.

title: Open a pull request
text: This pull request adds retry logic to the upload client. Previously, a single network error would cause the whole upload to fail. Now the client retries up to three times with exponential backoff before giving up. I also added tests for the retry behavior and updated the documentation.
